classification.summary: Zenspace Yoga (Lyon/Marseille) sells a 200h Vinyasa teacher training, Édition 2027, at Studio Spirale in Marseille with registrations open, and posted on September 18, 2026 a flyer for its own 'Retraite Yoga Rituels d'Automne' from the 15th to the 18th of an unreadable month in 2026 at a chalet, with yoga, Ayurveda, massages, vegetarian Ayurvedic meals and nature walks led by Pamela, Amandine & Anne-Lise (https://www.instagram.com/p/Da21MWnjQJR). The school organises its own retreats at external venues and runs recurring trainings, so it is group A in a priority market (France). The retreat is only 3 nights and the winter dates, group size and prices are unverified, so commercial risk is medium. Approach with a pilot 4-night winter edition of the Ayurveda retreat.
